newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Two killed, 15 injured in Bangladesh fire.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, 15 injured in Bangladesh fire.

text.p: Two people were killed and 15 injured when fire destroyed 300 shanty dwellings in a camp for stranded Pakistanis in the southern town of Khunla early on Sunday, police said.
Police said the fire, which originated from a leaf-roofed house at about 2.00 a.m. spread quickly and gutted most of the houses in the camp of more than 2,000 people.

The camp in the Khalishpur area of the town is one of 66 refugee shelters housing some 400,000 Urdu-speaking Moslems who sided with Pakistan during Bangladesh's 1971 war of independence and have since been stranded in this Bengali-speaking country.
The refugees' plea for repatriation to Pakistan, which they view as their homeland, has been virtually unheeded so far.
